etag.description: The entity tag of the row; send it back as `If-Match` or `If-None-Match`.

idempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response replays an earlier command with the same key.

keelwerkCommandId.description: The command id (the idempotency key, or one generated).

keelwerkEffects.description: The ids of the external effects the command requested, comma separated.

link.description: RFC 8288 links to the neighbouring pages.

location.description: Where the created row or the command receipt can be fetched.

requestId.description: The request id, also `requestId` of an error body.

idempotencyKey.description: The command id: a repeated key replays the first answer.
idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

ifMatch.description: The `ETag` of the version the change applies to; a mismatch answers 412.
ifMatch.name: If-Match

ifNoneMatch.description: An `ETag` the client holds; a match answers 304.
ifNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match

prefer.description: `respond-async` to get the 202 receipt, optionally with `wait=<seconds>` (at most 60).
prefer.name: Prefer

allOf.description: The row changed since you read it.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem; `code` identifies it everywhere (section 16.5.4).

parameters.description: Fields separated by commas; a leading `-` sorts descending.
parameters.name: sort
